question: Who is the new Managing Director of the National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) effective August 8, 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Rajkiran Rai.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The new Managing Director of NaBFID effective August 8, 2022, is Rajkiran Rai.**
 
• **Rajkiran Rai** is currently the **CEO and MD of Union Bank of India and will be taking over the new role after his tenure ends in July 2022.**
 
• NaBFID is a recently established financial institution in India that aims to provide long-term financing for infrastructure and development projects in the country.
 
• The institution was set up with an initial authorized capital of Rs. 20,000 crore and is expected to play a crucial role in financing infrastructure projects in India.
 
• Sumita Dawra is currently serving as the Executive Director of Union Bank of India, Arun Kumar Singh is an Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer, and Pankaj Jain is a Senior Vice President at Yes Bank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• NaBFID is a newly set up development financial institution (DFIs) in India.
 
• It has been set up for infrastructure financing as per the National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) Act 2021.
 
• The authorized share capital of the NaBFID is Rs one lakh crore.
 
• The initial paid-up capital of NaBFID is Rs 20,000 crore.
